translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

book.name: 1 Korintus
book.title: Surat ni Paulus Men Tumbena Bona Jama'at Na Kota KORINTUS

content: Biai' a barakaat kasee Alus Molinas sa'a-sa'angu'
Utu-utus! Koini'i yaku' muntundunkon barakaat men rookononna Alus Molinas. Yaku' mingkira' kada' i kuu minginti'i men tuutuu'na.
Kuu minginti'i se' na tempo i kuu sianpo ninginti'i Tumpu, kuu nibaetokmo pataka mangkanggi patung men umu'.

Mbaka' bantilkononku se' mian men tondongonna Alusna Alaata'ala, ia sian momoko mangaan “Bi kana'a tadean i Yesus!” Koiya'a uga' sianta sa'angu'po mian men momoko mangaan: “Yesus a men Tumpu!” kalu mian iya'a sian pisiso'onna Alus Molinas.
Isian biai' kaliangan a barakaat men ringkat na Alaata'ala, kasee giigii' rookononna Alus men sa'a-sa'angu'.
Isian biai' kaliangan a palimangon men sida limangon, kasee Tumpu men bo pinginti'i mase sa'a-sa'angu'!
Isian biai' kaliangan a palimangon men kosamba', kasee giigii' iya'a limangonna Alaata'ala men sa'a-sa'angu'.
Kita sanda-sanda' taraion barakaatna Alus Molinas men kumana' bo kaporeanta giigii'.
Isian mian men taraionna Alus iya'a barakaat pinginti'ian tempo morobu. Mian sambana taraionna Alus iya'a barakaat mompopo'inti'ikon Alaata'ala.
Mian sambana taraionna Alus iya'a barakaat imaan moonggor. Mian sambana taraionna Alus iya'a barakaat kuasa bo pengelesi'i mian.

Mian sambana taraion barakaat kuasa bo pangawawau upa kosamba'. Mian sambana taraion barakaat bo pantadulkon lele men ringkat na Alaata'ala. Mian sambana taraion barakaat minginti'i mindilang aana men Alus Molinas tia men taasi'. Mian sambana taraion barakaat momorobukon toropii kaliangan wurung men kobangang, ka' isian uga' mian sambana taraion barakaat minginti'i mangarat wurung men kobangang iya'a.
Giigii' barakaat iya'a limangonna Alus men sa'a-sa'angu' iya'a. Sanda' mian mandapot barakaat koi men kikira'na Alus rookonon na ko'ona.
Biai' a sampana waka kasee waka sa'a-sa'angu'
Wakana mian sa'a-sa'angu', kasee biai' a sampana. Giigii' sampana iya'a, mau mune' biai', mase galal sa'angu' waka. Kita men parasaya ni Kristus uga' koi wakana mian.

Kita men parasaya, mau lipu' Yahudi kabai se' lipu' Yunani, ata' kabai se' mian men sian nipo'ata', giigii' i kita ia saranimo Alus men sa'a-sa'angu' iya'a kada' daa i kita sida posa'angu'on na waka ni Kristus. Kita giigii' nitaraimo ninginum na Alus men koikoimo.
Wakana mian uga' biai' a sampana, taasi'po tongko' sangkaliangan.
Koi upa kalu se' sarat mangaan taena, “Yaku' taasi' lima, mbaka' i yaku' taasi'po sampana waka.” Tuutuu' mbali' a sarat se' sian tonsoop sampana waka?
Koi upa kalu se' tilinga mangaan taena, “Yaku' taasi' mata, mbaka' i yaku' taasi'po sampana waka.” Tuutuu' mbali' a tilinga se' sian tonsoop sampana waka?
Kalu wakana mian tongko' mata giigii', koi upa bo poorongorna waka iya'a? Kabai se' kalu wakana mian tongko' tilinga giigii', koi upa a waka iya'a sida poo'ook?
Kasee giigii' sampana waka iya'a ia pokela Alaata'ala na wakana mian koi pingkira'-Na.
Kalu giigii' sampana waka tongko' sangkaliangan, koi upa se' daa sida ngaanon waka?
Tuutuu' mba'a se' biai' a sampana waka, kasee waka sa'a-sa'angu'.
Mbali' mata sian sida mangaan na lima koi kani'imari: “Koo sian kumana' na ingku'!” Kabai se' takala' mangaan na sarat taena, “Koo sian kumana' na ingku'!”
Poali sampana waka men bookoi sian momoko ba'upa iya'a, ya'amo a men kumana' tuu' bo ko'onta.
Ka' sampana waka men bookoi sian angga'ion, ia a men angga'ionta tuu'. Sampana waka men sian sida pakatedaon na mian biai', imamatonta tuu'.
Kasee sampana waka men daa sida pakatedaon mosoo imamatonta. Alaata'ala nantapi'mo sampana wakanta pataka men sian laan angga'ion, ya'a a men imamaton tuu'.
Mbali' giigii' sampana waka sian sida poosinsala', kasee tio poo'imamat.
Kalu sa'angu' sampana waka karepaan, mbaka' sampana waka men sambana uga' tololo' munsuri karepaan. Kalu sa'angu' sampana waka angga'ion, mbaka' giigii' sampana waka uga' munsuri beles.
Kuu giigii' mase waka ni Kristus ka' i kuu sanda-sanda' mase sampana waka iya'a.

Koiya'a uga' a na lalomna jama'at. Alaata'ala namatukokonmo bookoi limangna sanda' mian. Men tumbena poposuu', korua'na nabii, kotolu'na guru, kasi mian men isian barakaat mangawawau upa kosamba', ka' uga' mian men isian barakaat mengelesi'i mian, kabai se' minsida mangalawei mian, kabai se' minsida mantanaasi, kabai se' men minginti'i momorobukon toropii kaliangan wurung men kobangang.
Raaya'a taasi' se' daa giigii' nosida poposuu' kabai se' nabii kabai se' guru. Taasi' se' daa giigii' isian barakaat bo pangawawau upa kosamba',
kabai se' bo pengelesi'i mian, kabai se' men bo pomorobukon wurung men kobangang, kabai se' bo pangarat wurung men kobangang iya'a.
Mbaka' kuu tiodaa mampari-pari mantausi na Alus Molinas barakaat men tuko. Ka' koini'i yaku' mompopo'inti'ikon na ko'omuu salan men porena tuu'.
